title: Superspace worldline formalism approach to Quantum Gravity: dimensional reduction and Holography
abstract: Demonstrates that the Hamiltonian formulation of quantum gravity takes the form of a worldline formalism within superspace using ADM formalism. Shows the Keldysh partition function reduces to Euclidean 3D gravity and connects to a 2D CFT generating functional through gauge field formalism. Through the Chern-Simons/Liouville correspondence, calculates the exchange of virtual gravitons between two massive probes from the cosmological boundary. The functional exhibits a minimal time-lapse proportional to the square root of the cosmological constant.
key_claims: Quantum gravity Hamiltonian formulation IS a worldline formalism in superspace
Keldysh partition function reduces to Euclidean 3D gravity
Connects to 2D CFT via Chern-Simons/Liouville correspondence
Calculates virtual graviton exchange between massive probes from cosmological boundary
Minimal time-lapse proportional to sqrt(cosmological constant) -- fundamental constraint on temporal evolution
Directly bridges worldline methods to holographic physics via dimensional reduction
